title: Reacting to News
goal: React to what other people do or say with me alegra que, lamento que and me sorprende que.

items: I can react to news with me alegra que, lamento que and me sorprende que.
I can use the subjunctive after a reaction, even when the news is a fact.
I can use the new words for reacting.
